theorem mvcc.ownToks_ones [go_etcd_io.etcd.cache.v3.Assumptions] (γ : GName) (n : Nat) : ownToks γ n
    ⊢ [∗list] _x ∈ List.replicate n (), ownToks γ 1

theorem mvcc.storeReaders_of_slots [go_etcd_io.etcd.cache.v3.Assumptions] (s : Loc) (γ :
    mvcc.StoreNames) (n : Nat) : (([∗list] _x ∈ List.replicate n (), sync.ownRWMutex (mvcc.muAddr s)
    (mvcc.muInv s γ)) ∗ ([∗list] _x ∈ List.replicate n (), sync.ownRWMutex (mvcc.revMuAddr s)
    (mvcc.revMuInv s γ)) ∗ [∗list] _x ∈ List.replicate n (), ownToks γ.tk 1) ⊢ [∗list] _x ∈
    List.replicate n (), mvcc.storeReaderC s γ

theorem mvcc.slot_take [go_etcd_io.etcd.cache.v3.Assumptions] (Q : IProp GF) : ([∗list] _x ∈
    List.replicate mvcc.nReaders (), Q) ⊢ Q ∗ (Q -∗ [∗list] _x ∈ List.replicate mvcc.nReaders (), Q)
